purpose: Evidence review and owner-approved educational AMH geometry; not clinical reference data

ownerApproval.scope: ordinary male lifespan/minipuberty/puberty views; approved before/after mockup; implementation requested

sources.locator: Figure 3, black GAMLSS median; vector PDF reading
sources.population: 119 healthy term boys, 338 serum samples, Copenhagen Minipuberty
sources.audit: Independent vector extraction; maximum difference from existing data 0.1764 pmol/L, smaller than printed line half-width ~21.78 pmol/L. This is graphical reading uncertainty, not biological confidence.

peak.note: The article longitudinal peak around day 146 is a different estimand.

sources.population: 2009 healthy boys, Wuhan; cross-sectional age groups
sources.statistic: year-group medians; not Tanner or exact-age medians
sources.referenceAge: 13 concordant groups labelled 1–11, 13 and 14; [N,N+1) is an explicit application convention
sources.audit: Primary page visually reviewed; existing 15 extracted rows agree. Groups 0 and 12 are contradictory between source tables and remain excluded.

sources.population: 831 healthy men aged 30–70, Tehran Lipid and Glucose Study
sources.assay: Modified AMH Gen II EIA, serum, morning fasting sample
sources.statistic: 41 yearly p50 predictions of an exponential-normal model
sources.audit: All 328 cells (41 rows including age and 7 centiles) match the primary XML; all 41 generated median values agree. Intermediate ages use application interpolation, not supplied author coefficients.

geometry.method: fixed source nodes plus cubic Bezier educational bridges, sampled for PCHIP rendering
geometry.prenatal: Relative schematic only; no numerical clinical reference or concentration tooltip.
geometry.tail: Hold last height and fade from 70 to 90; endpoint of available evidence, not a biological plateau.

constraints: No Tanner stage is inferred from chronological age or curve descent.
Cross-cohort bridges do not calibrate Access 2 with modified Gen II.
No new patient reference is obtained from a bridge or a tail.
Drawing medians at group midpoints does not make them exact-age measurements.
Owner mockup approval and technical checks are not clinical validation.

onlineMetadataReview.finding: Reviewed DOI metadata; Chong author-name erratum does not indicate changed numerical data. Other reviewed records did not list corrections; this does not exclude unindexed corrections.
